description: The surface set: the page and the two levels that rise from it, with a value per theme. Spacefast raises a surface by making it lighter than the page in both themes, which no single ramp step can say, so the pairing is made here and the common tier aliases one name. The screen is the one that sinks, for a container set into its surface as an LCD is. It is one primitive in both themes, the step after the page: a little darker than the page in light, and a little lighter than it in dark, where its inset shadow is what sinks it.
